messages:
Priya (Design): Uploaded quick mock of the vector preview table + export panel. Main asks: preserve row selection across filter/sampling toggles, make table keyboard-friendly, and clarify export UX for big jobs. screenshot: https://rwd-assets/vec-preview-export.png Leo (Eng): looked at mock. preserving checked rows is doable — store selected IDs separately from the rendered page index. big caveat: if sampling changes the rows shown, we need to warn users that some selected rows may no longer be visible. Olivia (PM): good point. Let's show a small banner when selection includes rows outside current sample: "16 selected (6 hidden by current filters). View hidden" with a link to reveal. Priya (Design): I like that. Also thinking about copy for the export button: currently says "Export" which is ambiguous for large exports. Suggest: "Start export" and secondary text: "You'll receive a download link when ready." Devon (Support): +1 for clear messaging. Also log a limit note somewhere: UI should remind users that exports over 50k vectors will run as background jobs and may take hours. We get support tickets if users expect immediate download. Sam (Accessibility): keyboard and a11y nits: table needs role="grid" and each row role="row" with cells role="gridcell". Use aria-selected on rows and ensure Space toggles selection. Also add a visible focus ring on the row, not just the checkbox. Sam (Accessibility): minimal code hint for Eng: ``` ...
Vector ID
``` Make sure the focused row gets tabindex="0" and others -1. Leo (Eng): implementation plan: we'll represent table selection in a selectedSet and sync checkbox state. For keyboard nav we'll implement roving tabindex so arrow keys move focus between rows and Space toggles aria-selected. Shift+click will do range select. Priya (Design): UX question: when a user clicks column header "Export columns" we show a modal checklist of fields. Should column visibility and export columns be separate? I think yes: column visibility affects preview only, export columns are persisted with the job. Add a small link in modal: "Use preview columns as export defaults" Olivia (PM): Persisting export column presets is important for repeatability. Add an option to save as a preset and name it. Also track who created the preset for team sharing. Devon (Support): for troubleshooting, include job metadata in the export email: preset name, filters applied, sample rate, export row count, and a link to retry. Sam (Accessibility): one more a11y item: the export progress notification should be announced via polite aria-live and visible in notifications center. ExportBot should post a message to channel when ready with clear filename and size. ExportBot: Export job queued (job id: job_9a7c). You'll get an email when complete. Leo (Eng): backend note: large exports will create an async job and S3 presigned link. We'll throttle concurrent exports per org to avoid spikes. We'll also provide a streaming CSV option for smaller exports (<10k). Priya (Design): thanks — i'll update the mock to show: preserved selection banner, "Start export" CTA with secondary line, column export modal, roving focus states, and progress toast. Posting v2 in ~3 hours. :sparkles: Olivia (PM): thanks team. I'll add acceptance criteria: preserve selection across filters, roving keyboard nav, aria grid roles, export preset save, background job messaging. Devon (Support): tagging for docs: add a KB entry about async exports and how to find download links. Priya (Design): noted. will include a screenshot for the KB."
